name: Coconut Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs less cloudy. Soak for 20 minutes, drain and measure fresh cooking water.

Cook the drained rice with 650 ml of the water and salt: bring to a boil, cover on low heat for 12–15 minutes, then rest off the heat for 10 minutes. Spread out gently so steam can escape. Heat the oil separately and sizzle cumin before making the tempering.
Sizzle mustard seeds and curry leaves, toast cashews until golden, then stir in coconut for 1 minute without browning it.
Fold the cooked rice gently into the prepared tempering or paste, keeping the grains separate. Warm over low heat for 2–3 minutes.
Taste and adjust the salt. Rest for 5 minutes so the seasoning distributes through the grains.
Fluff gently with a fork and serve hot. Cool any rice intended for later use promptly and refrigerate rather than leaving it warm on the counter.
tips: Taste at the end and adjust salt, heat and consistency before serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
